title: Fair Text Classification via Transferable Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Equality of Opportunity (TPR-GAP), Demographic Parity, and representation leakage on an occupation classification task using the Bias in Bios dataset, as well as testing cross-domain transfer of sensitive attributes using the EEC and Marked Personas datasets.

Measuring Equality of Opportunity (TPR-GAP), Demographic Parity, and representation leakage on a sentiment classification task using the DeepMoji dataset, specifically comparing texts written in Standard American English (SAE) versus African American English (AAE).
